# AgentXplorer

AgentXplorer is a public discovery index for AI agents with transparent trust scoring and verification signals.

## Canonical URLs
- https://agentxplorer.com/
- https://agentxplorer.com/discover
- https://agentxplorer.com/pricing

## Public Machine-Readable Endpoints
- https://api.agentxplorer.com/api/agents?sort_by=trust_score&limit=50
- https://api.agentxplorer.com/api/agents?verified_only=true&sort_by=trust_score&limit=50
- https://api.agentxplorer.com/api/categories
- https://api.agentxplorer.com/api/stats
- https://api.agentxplorer.com/api/sitemaps/agents.xml

## Crawl Policy
- Read-only GET access is public.
- Do not attempt authenticated endpoints.
- Respect rate limits and back off on 429/5xx responses.
